nonvacuity: Compiled scratch/Nonvacuity.lean with /home/ubuntu/sap/tools/sap-lean. On Omega = Bool x Bool x Bool with the uniform probability measure, take J=1, W the first fair bit, X=Y the second fair bit, Z the third independent fair bit, and V=W+XZ. The file constructs T11Population 1 Omega, proves monotonicity, the no-liars/design equality, full treatment independence for every function of (W,X,Y), and nondegeneracy, then compiles examples proving their conjunction and every extra positive-probability premise in clauses (a), (b), and (e), as well as 0 < alpha=1/2 < 1 and mu=1/2. Each (Z,Y) cell has probability 1/4 and conditional V variance 1/4; both binary marginal variances are 1/4. The two main computed hypothesis proofs use only propext, choice, and Quot.sound, without sorryAx or the target theorem.
